scope: Current-photo face/body panel measured brightest-retained-face suggestion with explicit user choice/override, genuine immutable native-precision source diagnostics, exact catalog/source/repair proof, existing sole people read queue and native receipt binding. No automatic correction or consent, new numerical algorithm, learned-AI or complete global face census claim.
requirement_identity_note: Preserved control key only; original lost hashed LNX mapping not invented.
manifest_policy: Exact 36 payload files plus this self-excluded manifest. Older/unrelated manifests excluded. No Git writes by worker.

source_checks.whitespace: All selected tracked/new text and EOF checked statically; git diff --check clean.
source_checks.cross_language: Host/native/UI exact report/proposal field sets statically compared. Actual canonical engine read envelope and native numerical tolerance reflected in authored fixtures.
source_checks.independent_review: Verified real Rust robust-luminance diagnostic indexes and read-only source/proof paths. Corrected pre-verifier snapshot admission ordering, storage-versus-measurement encoding mismatch, UI roundoff-band rejection and actual engine envelope mismatch. Final memory guard reread independently; no further definite engine/proof defect established in scoped static audit.
source_checks.execution: No product imports, tests, compiler, build, typecheck, inference, hardware, installs or downloads.

remaining: All numerical/ABI/GUI/real-photo/resource/performance/history/reopen/export acceptance remains UNRUN. No 24MP or preview/export pixel-parity guarantee.

Suggestion is brightest among enabled retained reliably measured faces under declared robust source luminance, not complete photograph detection, intrinsic complexion, demographic inference or proprietary metric parity. Unknown occlusion/detector/semantic errors require visual review.

Near ties, reached detector limit and unavailable enabled-face measurements block automatic nomination; user can explicitly choose a measured alternative. The result never auto-selects, grants ownership, acknowledges images or applies correction.

Existing face/body full mixed-image review still owns writes. Body ownership is manually reviewed with BodyRef evidence; no automatic instance segmentation. Common reference restrictions across retained face/body matching remain.

Source/review displays remain reduced RGB8, not native inspection. Immutable original PNG16/ICC16/RAW16 and canonical derived opaque SDR precision contracts retained; unsupported alpha/HDR refused without clipping.

Preset/batch/cohort/shared-source aliases, automatic consent/application and dedicated effect-recovery remain separate unfinished paths. This is one requirement extension, not an additional algorithm count.

Existing face-count, source/capture/fit/full-render memory and decoder/solver cancellation limits remain. Phase allowances record actual historical inputs; final actual admitted peak is bounded in source, not measured at runtime.

Read-only proposal uses original-request query/uncertainty safeguards and retained source catalog proof; evicted/stale catalog requires reload. No new mutation or history owner, no hot runtime plugin loading.
